I detected one regional marine heatwave in the region for June–August 2016. It runs from 2016-06-01 to 2016-06-18. Because the target period starts on 1 June, the event may have begun earlier and is truncated at the start of the analysed window.

Both files are written under `/work/output/`:
- `mhw_mask.nc` has the `mhw` variable (uint8, dimensions time × lat × lon) on the full 60 × 60 region grid, with 92 target days. It has 25,011 MHW cell-days.
- `report.json` holds the region, the baseline and target periods, the single event, `complete: true`, and a caveats note.

The region has 3304 sea cells, and 3134 of them had at least one per-cell MHW. The thresholds and climatology use the 1992–2002 baseline with the ±5-day windows and 31-day smoothing as specified. The baseline window was checked against the expected pool size of 121 values per day of year.
